readerCopy.body: A technological or cultural breakthrough arrives wrapped in a dream about how everyone will live next. A platform, medium, movement, or shared vision spreads quickly enough to reshape expectations before its limits and ownership are clear. Uranus breaks the familiar form, while Neptune surrounds the new possibility with hope, projection, and collective longing. Under the conjunction, innovation and idealization become part of the same wave. The change may open genuine freedom while making it difficult to tell where the future ends and the marketing begins.
